title: Why the Moon Shines
translation: Of the Earth, the planets and the stars, one half of each sphere is dark, in its own shadow. The halves facing the Sun shine, each according to its nature.
translation_hi: पृथ्वी, ग्रहों और नक्षत्रों के गोलों का आधा भाग अपनी ही छाया से अंधकारमय रहता है, और सूर्य की ओर वाला आधा भाग अपने स्वभाव के अनुसार प्रकाशित होता है।
question: What fraction of the Moon's surface is lit by the Sun at any moment? (Give a decimal.)
solution:
Exactly half (0.5): the hemisphere facing the Sun. The phases we see from Earth (crescent, half, full) are just how much of that lit half is turned toward us.

Science link: the Moon and planets do not make their own light; they reflect sunlight. That explains lunar phases, and Aryabhata also used the shadows of the Earth and Moon to explain eclipses correctly, instead of the demon Rahu swallowing the Sun.
